closure_summary.typed_boundary: validatePackagePlanIntegrity(plan, limits) returns an immutable ValidatedPackagePlanIndex on success; nested session/scene and session/group maps replace composite string keys.

closure_summary.pair_linkage: Every selected B in pair-bearing scopes requires exactly one matching selected A, exact numbering identity, exact IDs/labels, and canonical order. Failures map to EXPORT_LINK_001 / packaging.selection.outputsB with no package bytes.
closure_summary.partial_evidence: Policy-required identities must have the selected artifact or exact approved omission/registered-issue evidence. B may be omitted while A remains where policy permits; B may not survive without A.
closure_summary.group_reconciliation: Groups, group plans, group numbering, authoritative group/scene numbers, identities, cardinality, membership, and order are reconciled exactly.
closure_summary.trusted_consumers: Content, README, manifest, checksums, paths, and pair emission consume only the successful validated projection and trusted snapshots.
closure_summary.zip_writer: Programmer 1's strict descriptor-snapshot and exception-safe deterministic ZIP boundary is preserved unchanged.
closure_summary.external_verifier: All 10 golden fixtures plus checksum tamper, manifest tamper, and reordered-hostile fixtures are verified independently on disk with ZIP structure, extracted ledger, authoritative manifest schema, path/kind, size, digest, missing, and extra-file reconciliation.
